native_build.method: Recompiled every tracer-owned translation unit from candidate source, reusing source-built third-party archives. Main tracked source and linked libraries were not modified; the link command wrote generated dependency metadata in the cache.
native_build.metadata_note: The retained link command uses relative --dependency-file=CMakeFiles/qbdi_tracer.dir/link.d with cwd=archive_cache. This generated file contains candidate object paths and is not a compiled code input. Generated dependency metadata has since been restored using the baseline link inputs; a private relink matched the original unstripped binary SHA. Future private builds write their own dependency file.
native_build.limits: NDK relink against baseline source-built archives. This is not a fresh Gradle/package/release gate or full JNI matrix.

measurement.timing_scope: Single whole-target invocation per traced process, including QBDI JIT, mmap/libc and six SVCs. Same device/input/probe/companion; three interleaved legacy/off/on rounds. One prelaunch push timeout was excluded and the missing off measurement repeated.
measurement.conclusion: No performance benefit or zero-overhead claim. Noisy small cold-function sample; median differences are descriptive and do not isolate per-syscall overhead.
measurement.launcher_scope: Performance used the preceding launcher without configure-request.json persistence; target library, tracer and measured target body are unchanged. Final functional captures use a separate launcher hash.
